title: Exo Digger
description:
Earth, 2147. The planet is overpopulated and polluted. Billions of people live in poverty and unemployment. Only a select few the lucky winners of a lottery manage to secure jobs. CONGRATULATIONS!

You have won the Galactic Labor Reserve lottery!

XenoMining Inc. is sending you to Planet PX-173, where you will work in the mines.

• Contract duration: 6 months

• Job description: Mineral extraction

• Payment: Based on your mining performance

Exo Digger is a relaxing mining simulator set on a distant planet. Dig deep, extract rare minerals, upgrade your equipment, and expand your inventory. Explore the depths, but beware some areas of the mines may be dangerous. Who knows what secrets this planet holds beneath its surface? Keep digging, and perhaps fortune will smile upon you.

Welcome to a new world. Good luck!
